Best Drop Biscuits
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, February 24, 2010 - 11:35pm

Ingredients




2 cups flour
3 teaspoons baking powder
2 tablespoons sugar
1 teaspoon salt
 cup oil
1/4 cup milk
1/2 cup orange juice

Preparation

1 Use 2 tablespoons sugar, if using for shortcake. Use only 1 tablespoon for table biscuits. 2 Mix first 4 ingredients in large bowl. Mix next 3 ingredients in small bowl and pour into the dry mix in large bowl. Mix together. Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet and bake about 12 minutes at 450 degrees.
